title: The auditors need this file before they leave at noon
scenario: An email claiming to be from an external audit firm says a sensitive financial file must be uploaded to a shared link before the auditors leave at noon, or the finding goes down as unresolved.

answers.A: Upload the file quickly to the link to meet the deadline.
answers.B: Confirm the request with your own audit or compliance contact before sending anything.
answers.C: Upload the file, and also send a follow-up file they ask for afterward.

explanation: Real audit requests go through an established engagement contact and process; a same-day external deadline attached to a random shared link is a hallmark of a pretext for data theft.
proTip: A deadline set by the email itself is not a reason to skip verifying who's asking.
